clue.text: Make colleague confess to audience for stabbing

indicators.note: said to an audience, so the words are heard rather than read, signalling a sound-alike

parts.note: a colleague is a peer, and to confess is to sing (criminal slang for informing), so the words say PEER SING

explanation.surface: Someone is pressured into getting a coworker to admit to a stabbing in front of listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make colleague confess' is PEER SING, and 'to audience' says it is heard aloud, giving a word that sounds just like it.
explanation.definitionFit: A piercing pain or remark is sharp and penetrating, the same sense as a stabbing one.

clue.text: Shepherd found forgotten gold

parts.note: what is past is over and done, forgotten
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A shepherd stumbles on some gold that everyone had forgotten.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister who tends a congregation is figuratively a shepherd of the flock.

clue.text: Pass drinks and drugs around

indicators.note: the drug letters sit on either side of the drinking word, wrapping round it

parts.note: E is ecstasy, so two of them, Es, make EE
a cat or dog laps when it drinks

explanation.surface: Someone passes round drinks and drugs at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Time is said to pass or go by; the verb is a synonym for that.

clue.text: Interstellar space is ruptured by a site in flux

indicators.note: the space word is broken open and the other letters go into the gap

parts.note: a cell is a small enclosed space or compartment

indicators.note: in flux means changing and unsettled, so the letters of a site are rearranged

explanation.surface: A scientific note about interstellar space being torn apart by an unstable location.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interstellar' reads as an adjective on space, but it stands alone as the definition; 'space' is the small compartment of biology.
explanation.definitionFit: Something interstellar belongs to the heavens among the stars, a synonym of the heavenly adjective.

clue.text: Keeping sample of snow in situ at ionosphere's position is hopeless

indicators.note: the clue words keep a sample, a run of letters, within them for the solver to find

explanation.surface: A researcher keeps a snow sample in place at the edge of the ionosphere.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the N of snow and ends at the ION of ionosphere's, with the definition taking the words after.
explanation.definitionFit: A position that is hopeless is one in which nobody can come out ahead, the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: It is hard to read a single stroke

parts.note: S is an abbreviation for single, as on forms giving marital status
the crawl is a swimming stroke

explanation.surface: Someone peers at writing that is hard to decipher, made with one stroke of the pen.
explanation.definitionFit: Messy handwriting is illegible, so the word for it describes something hard to read.

clue.text: Copper article stores very soft tea

indicators.note: the copper-and-article pair holds the music letters within it

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a is the indefinite article
pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very soft

explanation.surface: A copper item holds very weak tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman, but here it is the chemical element.
explanation.definitionFit: A British colloquial word for a cup of tea.

clue.text: A fairy is able to raise drink

parts.note: a peri is a fairy in Persian mythology

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word writes it upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: fit means able or capable

explanation.surface: A fairy has the power to lift a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to raise' turns FIT into TIF at the foot of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcoholic drink taken before a meal to stimulate the appetite.

clue.text: One who hears the student is about to enter

parts.note: L for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

indicators.note: about signals the letters of enter are moved around

explanation.surface: A student is just about to come in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'nearly' in the surface but rearranges ENTER into TENER.
explanation.definitionFit: A listener is a person who hears, a straightforward description.

clue.text: It adds flavour running in wet racecourses

indicators.note: being run in, as a new engine is, puts the letters through their paces into a new order

explanation.surface: Horses running on racecourses after rain.
explanation.definitionFit: A pungent sauce shaken onto food, here described by what it does for a dish.

clue.text: Bird flying backwards amazes everyone inside

indicators.note: the word for everyone goes inside the turned letters
going in reverse, so the word for amazes is read from its end

parts.note: wows means amazes
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A bird flies backwards, astonishing all who watch.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a bird flying in reverse; 'flying backwards' instead signals reading the word for amazes from its end.
explanation.definitionFit: A swallow is a familiar migrating songbird.

clue.text: Abuse work by journalists

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
the press means journalists collectively

explanation.surface: A complaint about mistreatment in the work of reporters.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppress is to abuse or tyrannise people, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Put headless crows in ovens

indicators.note: removing the head of a word takes off its first letter

parts.note: to crow is to brag, so crows means boasts

explanation.surface: A grim cook puts decapitated crows into ovens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crows' looks like birds but is a verb for bragging.
explanation.definitionFit: Oasts are kilns for drying hops, a kind of oven.

clue.text: A peach of an entrance I made

indicators.note: something made has been put together, so the letters are constructed afresh

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of making a peach of an entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A peach' looks like praise for the entrance but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned variety of peach, so an example of the fruit.

clue.text: Public officials can easily be returned

definitions.meaning: a polite tennis serve is one the opponent finds easy to hit back

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the phrase literally: a courteous serve in tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of government officials employed in administration, plus a pun on a gentle serve.

clue.text: Excuse to dole out booze

parts.note: to ration is to dole out in measured amounts
ale is a kind of booze

explanation.surface: Someone justifies handing out drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the reasoning offered for something, a justification or excuse.

clue.text: Order dessert

definitions.meaning: a fruit pie served as a pudding

explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole the clue looks like an instruction in a restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a baked pudding and appears in the idiom for perfect order.

clue.text: Don't put in for holiday abroad

parts.note: leave is time off work, a holiday
abroad can mean out, outside one's home

explanation.surface: Someone decides not to apply for a holiday overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: To omit is to not include something, the phrasal verb's meaning.

clue.text: Maybe Betjeman or Wordsworth operate a lute badly

indicators.note: playing badly scrambles the letters of the phrase

explanation.surface: Two famous English poets play a lute poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: Both John Betjeman and William Wordsworth held the official post of royal poet, so they are examples.

clue.text: Taking only odd retired characters, gone in bible retreat

indicators.note: what retires goes back, so the picked letters are read in reverse
only the odd-numbered letters of the following words are kept

explanation.surface: Someone takes only strange characters who have gone into a bible retreat.
explanation.walkthrough: The odd letters of GONE IN BIBLE are GNIBBE; 'retired' turns them round. 'characters' is a link word naming letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide's going out is its retreat, so the verbal noun names that withdrawal.

clue.text: We are escorted by it girls and idiots

indicators.note: the first word is accompanied on both sides by the girls' word, so it goes inside

parts.note: debs, debutantes, are fashionable young society women

explanation.surface: Some young men accompanied by society girls are called fools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it girls' are glamorous socialites; the old word for a society girl coming out is a debutante.
explanation.definitionFit: Dweeb is American slang for a socially awkward, foolish person.

clue.text: Nothing is effective as marks of affection

parts.note: love is nil in tennis scoring
a measure that bites takes effect

explanation.surface: An observation that nothing is as effective as showing affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Bruises left by amorous kissing, literally marks of affection.

clue.text: Carrot and cheese cake for bachelor

indicators.note: to cake is to coat, so the cheese encrusts the bachelor letter

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese

explanation.surface: A dessert menu for a single man: carrot cake and cheesecake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cake' looks like a noun after carrot and cheese, but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrot dangled as an incentive is an inducement, as a bribe is.

clue.text: Steer front of boat at bend in river

parts.note: a steer is a castrated bull, an ox
the bow is the front of a boat

explanation.surface: Instructions to steer the front of the boat at a bend in the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steer' looks like a verb of navigation but is the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxbow is a U-shaped meander in a river.

clue.text: Almost in favour of protection for face condition

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: almost all of the word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: a visor protects the face

explanation.surface: Wearing a face shield is nearly a requirement.
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso is a stipulated condition in an agreement.

clue.text: Is girl similar or different?

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
like means similar

explanation.surface: A question about whether a girl resembles someone or not.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned word meaning not alike, so dissimilar.

clue.text: Credit note settles return

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: returning sends the word for settles back the way it came

parts.note: to meet a bill is to settle it

explanation.surface: A credit note settles a returned item.
explanation.definitionFit: To esteem someone is to give them credit, to hold them in regard.

clue.text: An eye for an eye and "a tooth for a tooth are religious lessons clerics, for example, held back

definitions.text: An eye for an eye and "a tooth for a tooth

parts.note: RE is Religious Education, a British school subject

indicators.note: the clerics' letters hold the turned abbreviation inside them

parts.note: Ven., Venerable, is the title of an archdeacon, so VENS are clerics

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation is read in reverse

explanation.surface: The biblical rule of retaliation is described as lessons taught by clerics in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: Venerable is the formal title of a Church of England archdeacon, which is why the abbreviation stands for clerics.
explanation.definitionFit: Each half of the old law of retaliation is an act of vengeance, hence the plural.
